study: CPI v2 shelter Rent/OER first vintage pilot

rejected.reason: ALFRED initial shelter index not available on this date
ALFRED initial shelter index not available on this date

methods.baseline: Simple average of previous 3 CPI shelter MoM readings
methods.v2: 0.4 latest + 0.6 three-month mean for Rent and OER; remaining shelter reconstructed from parent CPI shelter and event-date available BLS component weights

conclusion: On first 14 valid CPI releases, the detailed shelter submodel does not outperform a simple 3m shelter rate in mean absolute error. The tiny RMSE improvement is not enough to claim predictive superiority.
limitations: Shelter-only—not full CPI or Core CPI v2 backtest
ALFRED first-available seasonally adjusted index outcomes, not yet transcribed original BLS printed press figures
Historical BLS annual weights are available as of the forecast date; monthly exact weights and possible post-publication changes not audited
Short period (2023-2024) not representative of all inflation regimes
